title: El-Sayed Built Win on Michigan College Towns and Educated Voters
title_cn: 埃尔·赛义德在密歇根大学城和受过教育的选民中赢得了胜利
summary: Abdul El-Sayed’s victory in Michigan’s Democratic Senate primary was powered by college towns and highly educated counties that broke hard for the progressive outsider, while Haley Stevens ran up margins in working-class communities across the state.

title: Milei Guts Bill to Ease Property Laws in Face of Public Uproar
title_cn: 面对公众的骚动，米莱勇敢地提出放宽财产法的法案
summary: President Javier Milei’s latest push to lure private investment to Argentina suffered a setback Wednesday as lawmakers watered down legislation to ease limits on foreign land ownership in response to fierce backlash.
